Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle thbuild independently or together with one or two colleagues. This high-tech organisation develops and builds machines for the global market, with locations in Europe, China and the United States. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.
